'''Widow's Perch''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Ash Heap]] region of [[Appalachia]]. By [[Timeline#2103|2103]], the area has been made into a base for the [[Blood Eagles]].

==Background==
Built on the slope of the mountain and hidden from prying eyes lurking on the ground by a [[Lone Wanderer (vehicle)|Lone Wanderer]]'s billboard, the denizens of this dwelling bought themselves time, but could not outrun the fate that befell all of Appalachia.

==Layout==
Widow's Perch is a crude wooden shack built on the edge of the Ash Heap near [[the Forest]]. There is a small [[Cooking station (Fallout 76)|cooking station]] on the northwest side of the roof. The top floor has random debris piles, an [[Armor workbench (Fallout 76)|armor workbench]], and a [[brewing station]]. There are a mattress and a wooden crate on the next floor down. 

The bottom level has a suspended bridge that extends across to a billboard with a gap in the middle. In the pit below the gap, there is a level 3 locked safe. There are a footlocker and a cooler at the end of the billboard bridge.

==Notable loot==
* Potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] - On the top of the billboard, on the southern end of the plank bridge which connects the shack to the billboard.
* Potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] - Near a cinder block on the floor below the workbenches.
* Potential [[Fallout 76 plans|plan]] - Sitting on a wooden shelf to the left of the metal box on the top floor.
* [[Fusion core (Fallout 76)|Fusion core]] - Sitting on a wooden shelf above a metal box, on the balcony of the top floor.

==Appearances==
Widow's Perch appears only {{In|FO76}}.
